MUS.note: Minister only says AI-linked legal issues are being considered; no draft, rule or authority stated.
No government use of AI stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in the country stated.

facts.fact: The Acting Prime Minister cited figures published by the Mauritius Digital Promotion Agency, based on data from the ICT Authority and CERT-MU, showing reported security incidents rose from 5,221 in 2024 to 6,073 in 2025.

MUS.note: Cybercrime case counts are reported cases, not use of a law; the law is only said to be under review.
The 82.5 per cent is the minister's 'internet penetration', not stated as a share of people using the internet.
No cut, punishment or public criticism of a government policy stated.
